title: Primary Industries Levies and Charges Collection Bill 2023
short_title: Primary Industries Levies and Charges Collection Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would replace the current 1991 Act to create a modernised framework for collecting agricultural levies and charges.
It would clarify the roles of levy payers, charge payers and collection agents, and introduce collection rules for each commodity.
The bill would also trigger enforcement powers from the Regulatory Powers Act and introduce infringement notices and civil penalties for proportional responses.
changes: Replaces the Primary Industries Levies and Charges Collection Act 1991.
Clarifies roles of participants using consistent terminology.
Provides for collection rules setting out specific obligations.
Triggers monitoring, investigation, and enforcement powers of the Regulatory Powers (Standard Provisions) Act 2014.
Introduces infringement notices and civil penalties.
Provides for appropriate use and disclosure of information with safeguards.
summary.affected: Farmers, producers, processors, exporters, and collection agents in agricultural, fisheries and forestry industries.

The addenda respond to matters raised by the Scrutiny of Bills Committee. Question agreed to. Bills read a second time.
